changes.before: Export, Results, About; every setting on the Export tab
changes.now: Export, QC, Deliver, About. Project type and What to export are two dropdowns in one row; size, naming, QC and review settings sit behind one Output line and the settings button (one section open at a time). Header, tabs and footer stay put, only the list scrolls

changes.before: same as AC: 4K, every file under 2 GB
changes.now: 8K source → 4K at 4.5–4.8 GB, max 200 Mbps; 4K source stays 4K, max 90 Mbps, under 2 GB. AC folders keep under 2 GB. Settings › Size + bitrate can force AC or Client

changes.before: Verify files by hand: size, codec, frame size
changes.now: each queued file is checked as soon as Media Encoder finishes it (panel open): black or still frames at start/end, loudness (−14 ±1 LUFS on Normal export, info on colour grading), duration = timeline, codec/frame/fps/size band. 4 dots per file, details on click, Go to problem in the timeline, Mac notification

changes.before: file name = clip or sequence name
changes.now: template with chips {Project} {Sequence} {Clip} {Ratio} {Date} v{NN}; Normal default {Project}_{Sequence}_{Clip}_{Ratio}_v{NN}, next free version, never overwrites. Colour grading keeps {Clip}

chips Master + Social (1080 wide, 8 Mbps, fast start, loudness target) + Review pack (720p copy under 16 MB, contact sheet, cover PNG from a “cover” marker); made from the master after it passes QC, in Social/ and Review/ next to the exports

changes.before: Whole sequence or Clips by cuts
changes.now: 3rd option: sequence markers named “Clip …” start a video that runs to the next Clip or End marker (a marker with a duration is its own range)
banner when the saved project's Viewer Gamma is not 1.96; Set 1.96 saves, closes, changes only that setting and reopens (backup kept)

only QC-passed files: copy to a Google Drive for desktop folder (account picked from this Mac), QC report, and a hand-off prompt for Claude to move the Asana task to QC 1 and draft the Slack note; a summary to confirm first

changes.before: one mode: colour-grading export (one file per enabled V1 clip, 4K, under the size cap, 1-frame clean edge)
changes.now: switch at the top of Export: Color grading export (unchanged) or Normal export
one file per ticked sequence, the full timeline (Entire Sequence), named after the sequence; nested sequences start unticked

several videos in one sequence are found by their longest layer (background, BGM, or an adjustment layer named "Clip N"); every shorter layer inside belongs to that clip; files Sequence_Clip01, 02…; exact frames, no edge offset; full-length logos/watermarks ignored
H.264, match source frame and frame rate (scaled only above 4K), medium bitrate VBR 1-pass (about 10 Mbps for 1080×1920 @30, 40 for 4K @30), AAC 320 kbps, no size cap; Verify skips the cap

changes.before: In/Out set on the enabled clip's exact edges in seconds; rounding could pull in the neighbouring disabled (black) frame
changes.now: In = clip start + 1 frame, Out = clip end - 1 frame, both aimed a quarter frame into the frame (measured: Premiere keeps the frame the In falls in and stops before the frame the Out falls in), matching the Luma Cut IN/OUT markers; clips of 10 frames or less unchanged. Tested on AC#13 26 Nov

changes.before: did not say which media an export reads
changes.now: Source: original media, never proxies. Checked: a Media Encoder export with a marked proxy attached and proxies on contained none of the proxy
New updates: every version with its date, time and what changed

changes.before: Cmd+Z did nothing while the panel had focus
changes.now: Undo and Redo buttons in the header; Cmd+Z / Shift+Cmd+Z work inside the panel too
same design as Luma Cut: charcoal, #FA914F accent, icons
Export, Results, About
Verify files: exists, H.264, frame size and size cap per file
